verdict.line: You lose if you let her stack W (Harsh Lesson) leaps and tentacle hits on you in melee before level 6; you win if you hold Q (Corrosive Charge) range and land R (Fear Beyond Death) executes after.

brief.thesis: Urgot is fully ranged (Q 800, W 490) against a melee champion whose only gap closer, W (Harsh Lesson), is a short 400-range leap on a 4-second cooldown — this lane is decided by whether Urgot keeps the fight at Q distance or gets dragged into point-blank trades where her tentacles and passive sustain take over. The 49.5% win rate over 729 games says it's close, but the measured lane and solo-kill edge both go to Illaoi, so play it as a poke-and-wait matchup, not a brawl.

theirWindow.when: right after she lands E on you
theirWindow.what: She'll have tentacles or Q (Tentacle Smash) hit the spirit for free echoed damage back onto you, and staying too far from the spirit turns you into a Vessel that spawns tentacles against you — back off the spirit immediately instead of trading through it.

yourWindow.when: the instant her W (Harsh Lesson) whiffs or hits a minion
yourWindow.what: She has no gap close for 4 seconds — step up, land Q (Corrosive Charge) and a few autos for Echoing Flames procs, then reset to max range before it's back up.

start.why: The 50.6% winrate, 82.7% pick-rate start over 767 games — the extra sustain and auto damage help you survive the level 1-2 window where her short trades beat you.

boots.why: 49% winrate, 69.1% pick-rate — flat physical damage reduction directly answers her autos, W (Harsh Lesson) hits, and tentacle swings, all of which are physical.

core.why: Armor shred plus attack speed turns your kiting autos into real damage once she's forced to close with W.
The bonus health and shield absorb the burst from a W leap + tentacle + E (Leap of Faith) all-in before you can disengage.
Highest-winrate of the listed core paths (55.4% over 65 games) — Grievous Wounds from being hit cuts the healing her tentacle passive gives her off you, which is her main lane sustain.

situational.when: you're laning near walls early and her tentacles are healing her off every trade
she itemizes into extra lifesteal or healing to outlast your poke
the game goes long and she's building to dive you in skirmishes near terrain

runes.keystoneWhy: The higher-winrate page (53.6% over 15% pick rate) — the vulnerable debuff rewards you for landing autos during your short poke windows before she closes distance.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 83% of games at 49.5% winrate — Ignite's burn secures the R (Fear Beyond Death) execute threshold earlier and denies tentacle sustain during a dive. Flash+Teleport (49.2%, 14% pick) is the alternative if you need safer wave priority given her lane edge.

playing.title: Poke from Q range, not melee
playing.detail: Fire Q (Corrosive Charge, 800 range) behind minions whenever it's up on its 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s cooldown instead of walking in to auto — you out-range everything she has except E's setup.

playing.title: Respect the 4-second leap
playing.detail: W (Harsh Lesson) is only 400 range but recycles every 4 seconds, so never dangle in that range band expecting it to be down for long.

playing.title: Trade only when her Q is spent
playing.detail: After she smashes a tentacle with Q (Tentacle Smash, 10-6s cooldown) her burst drops — that's your window to step in with W (Purge) for a short attack sequence.

playing.title: Lane away from walls
playing.detail: Her tentacles only spawn on impassible terrain, so holding the open side of the lane denies the extra hits and heals that come with them.

playing.title: Disengage off her spirit, don't fight through it
playing.detail: If her E (Test of Spirit) lands on you, back off immediately so tentacles or Q can't smash the spirit and echo damage back onto you.

playing.title: Hold E (Disdain) for escape, not engage
playing.detail: With lane and solo-kill advantage on her side, Disdain is your safety valve out of an all-in, not your opener.

playing.title: Hunt the level 6 execute
playing.detail: Once R (Fear Beyond Death) is up, any poke that drops her below the threshold is a kill at 2500 range — Ignite extends that window further.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the mechanical reasoning and trade-pattern advice are my own analysis layered on top.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit with her (E). Try to keep some distance rather than fighting in close combat to slowly apply pressure.
